command.description: Exact Shell command passed verbatim as `/bin/sh -c <command>`; required only for terminal tasks and forbidden for codex/claude tasks.

context.description: Optional, any JSON; forwarded to the worker verbatim.

cwd.description: Absolute path; terminal worker cwd + gate default cwd.

depends_on.description: Sibling task keys that must be done first.

gate.description: Verification the kernel runs after the worker reports done; declare one for every agent task. Steps run in order, first non-zero exit fails the gate, and steps must be re-runnable (kernel restarts re-run the gate).

cwd.description: Absolute path; defaults to task.cwd, else the track cwd.

cmd.description: Shell command; must be re-runnable. Non-zero exit fails the gate.

name.description: Step label; the failing step is attributed in the gate result.

timeout_secs.description: Whole-gate timeout in seconds; default 1800, max 7200. Timeout fails the gate.

goal.description: Natural-language objective; required only for codex/claude tasks and forbidden for terminal tasks.

key.description: Stable per-track task key; also the completion correlation id.

no_gate_reason.description: Escape hatch: justifies an ungated agent task on a track with `require_task_gates`; recorded into context for audit. Must be a non-empty reason (whitespace-only is rejected).

message.description: Required human-readable rationale for this write. The kernel persists it on the emitted event as agent_message.

ops.description: Ordered block ops; may be omitted or empty.

id.description: upsert (replace) / move / delete: the existing block id. Omit on upsert to create.

if_rev.description: Optional on upsert-with-id and delete: the block's rev. Omitted: the rev this session last read.

markdown.description: upsert, kind=prose: the content. replace: the whole section.

payload.description: upsert, data kinds: the schema-validated payload (see calm.report.blocks.kinds).

section.description: replace / delete: the section's H1 text; replace's `markdown` is the whole section, heading first.

summary.description: New sidebar summary (~80 chars). Omit to keep the existing one.

resolve.description: Per-block hydration override for `chart.series` and live `table` blocks: `{ [block_id]: "full" | "none" }`. Default (no entry) is the summary.

select.description: What to return: "full" (default; `text` + index), "index" (`docRev`, `summary`, `blocks`, `taskDiagnostics` — no `text`), or `{ "blocks": ["b_x", …] }` (index + `text` holding only those blocks in document order, each preceded by its `<!-- neige:b_x -->` marker line; an unknown id is an error), or `{ "sections": ["H1 text", …] }` (the same for every block of those H1 sections; an unknown section is an error).

with_markers.description: Inject a `<!-- neige:b_xxxx -->` marker line before each block in `text` (default false; always on for `select.blocks` / `select.sections`).

body.description: Full report Markdown, optionally with `<!-- neige:b_xxxx -->` marker lines.

if_doc_rev.description: The document-wide docRev returned by calm.report.read; not a block rev.

message.description: Optional human-readable rationale for this write, persisted as agent_message on the emitted event.

producer.description: Exact same-Track candidate producer key; use repair_key for C2.

name.description: Nonempty after trim, at most 200 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters; immutable Track-local Dispatch identity.

plugin_tools.description: plugin.<id>_<tool> names delegated to the Worker through platform MCP; the Codex-sanitized spelling from your tool list ([^A-Za-z0-9_] shown as _) is accepted and resolved to the registry name. Omitted means no plugin grants. Frozen for replay and recovery; current Track scope and plugin availability still apply. Ordinary tools only, no ForgeAction tools or wildcards.
